expressions.bm_formal: Menyelesaikan masalah / Mengesan dan membaiki masalah

work.scenario: During a project meeting, you need to discuss the progress and any technical issues. You mention that the client needs an update and there's a problem to troubleshoot before the new module can be launched.
key_phrases: Kita perlu mengemaskini pelanggan tentang status projek.
Ada masalah teknikal yang perlu kita selesaikan sebelum melancarkan modul baru.

life.scenario: Your phone is running slow, and you realize it needs an update. Before doing so, you want to back up your photos and ask a friend for help to connect your phone to a laptop.
key_phrases: Telefon saya kena update ni, tapi saya nak backup gambar dulu.
Boleh tolong sambung telefon saya ke laptop tak?

tech.scenario: In a discussion about a new app feature, you talk about the development process, ensuring data backup, and connecting new servers.
key_phrases: Pasukan kita sedang membangunkan ciri baru untuk aplikasi.
Sebelum kita lancar, kita mesti pastikan semua data pengguna dibuat salinan sandaran dengan selamat.
Bagaimana kita nak sambung pelayan baru ini ke rangkaian sedia ada?

quiz_toggle.question: How do you say 'to update (information)' in formal Malay?
What's the casual Malay for 'to troubleshoot a problem'? (解决问题)
If you want to say 'to launch a new system' in formal Malay, what would you use?
What is the casual Malay for 'to connect (devices)'? (连接设备)
How do you formally say 'to back up data'?
What is the casual Malay for 'to develop a new feature'? (开发新功能)
quiz_toggle.answer: Bangunkan ciri baru / Buat ciri baru
